rev.t: I would advise against purchasing from Dry Fruits Gallery. They overcharge and there have been issues with incorrect billing, which appears misleading.
Miniature version of EK Retail, it's parent shop down the road. Stocks all day to day living needs.
It's regular go to shop for all daily home needs. Eager to help staff. They also try to get the things quickly from their chain of shops quickly when something not in this store. …
